item.title: Sugar Coat Freaks
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Littlewitch
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 7.35/10 (34 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シュガーコートフリークス
  • 英語名: Sugar Coat Freaks

あらすじ

Haru is a second year student at the prestigious Ruritania Royal College. One day, a small girl appears and issues him an order. She is Tamahime, a princess from the distant Oukoku, who wanted to try living the life of a commoner. To this end, she pretends to be Haru’s little sister Tamako and transfers into Ruritania.

item.title: Period
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Littlewitch
  • 発売日: 2007-11-26
  • スコア: 7.13/10 (634 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ピリオド
  • 英語名: Period

あらすじ

“Dear God, I now make this, the single request of my life…”

—–The near future, Nagasaki.

Into this city, with its long and checkered past

was born a rarity: a child with wings.

I don’t know when it started, but

The school overlooking the town

came to be known as hallowed ground –

and that is where we met.

item.title: Rondo Leaflet
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Littlewitch
  • 発売日: 2007-01-26
  • スコア: 8.02/10 (81 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ロンド・リーフレット
  • 英語名: Rondo Leaflet

别名

  • The Suffering of Steward Matthew

あらすじ

Rondo Leaflet took place in United Kingdom 1892.

Matthew Hamilton is a young servant. As he chose the same job as his father without really caring about it, he has no enthusiasm for service and has been fired five times. The servants’ association treats him as a headache, and was about to take his name off the books. To his fortune, he got a final chance: working at a ruined peers’ house for free. In fact, that house has very many troubles. Maids are very slack in their work because wages are not paid, the house itself is very dirty, and the landlady doesn’t have a very good character as well.

别名

あらすじ

Four moons illuminate the sky in an alternate world governed by swords, magic, and monsters. This realm, known as Stellamund, transitioned from the tumultuous “Age of Tower” to the flourishing “Age of Crown.” During the bygone era, wizards who ignited a catastrophic war have since lost their influence and now quietly delve into arcane studies at the Grimoire Academy.
